summary: Establish the SourceDAO Solidity security and deterministic contract artifact baseline
details: SourceDAO now runs pinned Slither analysis in a report-only workflow that fails on scanner or malformed-report errors without blocking development solely because findings exist.
The USDB contract build records and checks compiler settings, ABI, selectors, creation and runtime bytecode, and storage layout for all eight production contracts.

The centralized security registry distinguishes confirmed governance and accounting defects from mitigated bootstrap risks and static-analysis false positives before contract bytecode changes are made.
